operations.read_revision: typed current revision and digest read
operations.write_event: compare-and-swap event write requiring exact expected revision

request.payload: bounded event kind and sha256 event digest only
request.auth: opaque auth reference plus derived proof digest; no credential value

retry.idempotency: same operation ID and canonical request returns the original response; changed replay rejects

ambiguity.write: transport loss after commit returns unknown_outcome and never guesses success
ambiguity.recovery: the caller may reconcile by repeating the identical operation ID or reading the current revision

failure_semantics.external_effects: none in this AR: no network, provider, LLM, hosted CI, Git, or live Coordinator

evidence_boundary.offline: in-process fake, deterministic fault injection, fixture and hostile checker
